args.head: fix/cve-2026-31337-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (fix CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

- Affected: <2.9.4, >=3.0.0 <3.1.0; fixed in 2.9.4 and 3.1.0.
- Chose 2.9.4 as the minimal fix within the current 2.x major line to avoid a major-version upgrade.
- Updated CHANGELOG.md.
